decisions.checkpoint: Persist ArmyEventOrder, paid event face and parent cursor; commit one fixed group and explicit route atomically. Relief persists a parent-return battle with CombatDiceReduction.
decisions.cancel: Undo changes the local group/route; the already played event is committed and its mandatory decision cannot be skipped.

decisions.visibility: Public Nazgûl and destinations; current draft only to its owner
decisions.next_window: Parent event: Fellowship revelation, Hunt or table-card choice
decisions.checkpoint: Persist EffectWait.NazgulTravel, paid event and parent cursor. Commit all flight groups or an explicit empty selection once; no second die. Validate against live figures and legal flight destinations.
decisions.cancel: Back changes the local draft. Stay all clears planned groups; confirming ends movement and resumes the already committed event.

decisions.visibility: Public paid cost and completed steps; decision and legal options only to owner
decisions.next_window: Next step, final excess/political/cost reaction, or next action
decisions.checkpoint: Persist every Stepwise commit with paid cost, used figure IDs/settlements, remaining budget and initial character candidates. FinishActionSequence resolves end-of-action effects once.
decisions.cancel: Only unsent local choices can change. A committed step cannot be undone; explicit Finish forfeits the remaining budget.
